audit_scope: Classical diffeomorphism NHIM definition applied to the positive-dimensional cylinder extension

source.title: A geometrical proof of the persistence of normally hyperbolic submanifolds

bounded_inference: The cylinder map is classically normally expanded at the invariant circle under Definition 1, with Es=0, unstable inverse norm 2/3, tangent norm 1, and lambda 3/4.
nonclaims: The positive-dimensional circle still has zero ambient volume and does not prove positive-volume confinement.
ASMP-4 does not itself select this classical diffeomorphism definition or the cylinder class.
The definition audit is not external expert review and does not prove the full variational conjecture.
